variants.A: Original character for an anti-gravity arcade racing game roster (not based on any existing character). A pop-idol racer with long white hair with pink tips, a white and hot pink racing outfit, holographic star hair clips, a playful wink. Bust portrait facing the viewer, filling the square image edge to edge: no frame, no border, no screen, no arcade cabinet, no panels, no text, no letters, no logos. Stylized semi-cartoon comic-book look of a 1990s arcade racing game character select portrait, bold colours, strong neon rim light in cyan and magenta, dark background with a glowing perspective grid, Tron and Ready Player One cyberpunk flavour.
